_doc: Research bandit (2026-10-02). Units: expected PUBLIC Global-WP gain over the current best single model, x1e-4. mu/sd = prior/posterior belief for the arm's best achievable gain; cost_h = GPU hours to the next decision point (2-fold screen unless noted); horizon_h = GPU hours left to the deadline. Update after every pull (ledger id in 'pulls'). noise_sd = sd of one pull's measurement (2-fold screen ~4; public pull ~5 incl. seed noise).

target_stopped_bootstrap.evidence: unbiased by optional stopping; run-coherent noise 9x lower than alpha 0.7 (E-334); toy +0.0004

arch_lstm_student.evidence: plain LSTM -0.0013..-0.0035 vs GRU (E-081, E-168); distilled + bag-diversity untested

arch_tcn_student.evidence: never tested; L2-resident weights could make wider/extra members cheap

arch_two_timescale_state.evidence: half the loss in class-3 long quiet runs (E-323); dual-clock rejected but confounded (freeze bug per audit)

data_all_valid.status: needs a public pull (no local holdout left)
data_all_valid.evidence: teammate: valid weight 1x vs 0x +0.0011; holdout = 20% of valid unused by finals; lit-scout scaling law E-152 +0.0034/doubling -> ~+0.00015 for 368 seqs

seed_bag_engine.evidence: holdout pair +0.0005 over singles; runtime 439 kcyc vs gate 423; lit-scout: DeltaGRU column skipping -29% MAC at fidelity 1.000000 (bit-exact on quantized activations), low-rank layer-2 SVD r=128 fidelity 0.99968 -20% MAC

input_representation.evidence: DTW, i1 lead-lag, analogs, retrieval all null

distill_rb_weight.evidence: Rao-Blackwellised KD weight: E[|y| x] head instead of realised |y|; same minimiser, lower variance, uses y=0 rows (Menon 2021); stacks with stopped bootstrap

distill_patient.evidence: Beyer 2022 patient/consistent KD: 8 epochs, teacher relabels the student's exact augmented view
